title: Revolut Mobile to shake up the Irish telco market with unlimited 5G ready plans from just €9.99 a month
body_markdown:
-


*Revolut is introducing Revolut Mobile plans in Ireland powered by Gigs – with an introductory price of just €9.99 per month for the first 25,000 customers to sign up (€12.99 per month standard, on a cancel-anytime rolling contract)*


-


*Offered via eSIM, customers can activate their flexible plan in seconds, directly within the app – eliminating the need for physical SIM cards*


-


*Powered by Gigs, Revolut Mobile delivers high-speed, reliable 5G ready coverage in Ireland, and includes 20GB roaming in UK & EEA, NordVPN, and a Messaging Pass*


**Dublin, Ireland**


**& San Francisco, USA,** **November 9th 2026**


– Revolut, the global financial leader with over 3.4 million customers in Ireland and more than 80 million users worldwide has announced the launch of Revolut Mobile – with plans starting from just €9.99. For Irish consumers, Revolut Mobile redefines what users can expect from mobile connectivity.


The first 25,000 customers to sign-up to Revolut Mobile can secure an introductory price of €9.99, or €12.99 per month for those thereafter.


This feature-packed mobile plan combines unlimited 5G-ready data, calls, and texts, as well as 20GB of data roaming across the UK and EEA.


Uniquely, Revolut Mobile also includes a Messaging Pass at no extra cost. This 1GB of additional low-speed data covers more than 120 non-EU countries worldwide and is designed for general-use and text messaging wherever users are, never leaving them without a connection.


In addition, Revolut Mobile customers can also redeem their RevPoints, earned through everyday spending via their Revolut Bank debit or credit card, for discounts. Customers can therefore shrink their bill by up to 100% – effectively removing one of their monthly expenses.


To provide a representative example, a customer on Revolut Bank's Ultra plan, being billed the introductory €9.99 price, would need to spend approximately €1,400 a month to accrue sufficient RevPoints to cover their bill entirely, or roughly €1,800 at the €12.99 price point. In the other markets where Revolut Mobile is present, over a third of customers paid with RevPoints in September.


Furthermore, Revolut Mobile customers can either hold onto their existing number, change to a new one, or shop from a VIP range for that extra personal touch. Designed for separating work and personal life, there is also the option to hold multiple numbers across one plan – with up to three separate numbers available, costing from just an extra €2 per month.


Ultimately, Revolut Mobile challenges outdated industry trends by doing away with long-term contracts, annual mid-term price hikes, and hidden activation fees. The service can be managed end-to-end within the Revolut Bank app, giving customers total transparency and month-to-month flexibility – with no paperwork and the ability to cancel at any time.


Built in partnership with embedded connectivity leader Gigs, the service is activated in seconds from within the app, and provides fast, reliable coverage across Ireland and abroad.


As an additional perk, secure browsing with NordVPN is also included with plans at no extra cost – enabling Revolut Mobile customers to block ads, guard against malware, and get online with peace of mind.


**Elyas Sadou, General Manager – Telecom at Revolut, said:**


*“We are bringing the same challenger mindset to telecommunications that helped us transform digital banking. Mobile contracts in Ireland have – for too long – been burdened by lofty pricing, hidden fees, and rigid long-term commitments. Revolut Mobile changes that by delivering flexible, premium connectivity managed entirely within the Revolut Bank app — allowing customers to utilise the RevPoints they earn on everyday spending towards their mobile plan.”*


**Hermann Frank, Co-Founder & CEO at Gigs, added:**


*“Over 80% of adults in Ireland already bank with Revolut. From today, the same app keeps them connected too. Combining money and mobile creates value neither could deliver alone. RevPoints earned on card payments cover the phone bill. Worldwide, fee-free spending and messaging are now the same product. Europe’s most powerful mobile experience is now at the fingertips of millions of Irish consumers.”*


---


**About Revolut Bank**


Revolut Bank UAB is a licensed European bank that helps people get more from their money. In 2015, Revolut launched in the UK offering money transfer and exchange. Today, more than 80 million customers around the world use dozens of Revolut’s innovative products to make more than a billion transactions a month.


Across our personal and business accounts, we give customers more control over their finances and connect people seamlessly across the world.


18+, Fees and T&Cs apply. Banking services and Revpoints are provided by Revolut Bank UAB, Ireland Branch. Mobile connectivity services are provided by Gigs (Gigs Wireless Ireland Ltd). Revolut Ltd acts as a commercial agent on its behalf.


More information at


[https://www.revolut.com/en-IE/](https://www.revolut.com/en-IE/)


**About Gigs**


Gigs, the operating system for mobile services, empowers companies to embed connectivity into their product. By bundling phone plans and travel data with their core services, Gigs' customers can increase stickiness and unlock a new recurring revenue stream with digital mobile experiences that create meaningful value for consumers. Trusted by the world's leading tech companies including Revolut, Klarna, Cash App, Nubank and Motorola, and backed by Ribbit Capital, Google and Y Combinator, plus the CEOs of Uber, DoorDash and OpenAI, Gigs was founded in 2020 by Hermann Frank and Dennis Bauer. For more information,


[visitgigs.com](http://visitgigs.com/) .


---


*Introductory price of €9.99 runs for the first 25,000 unique users to sign-up or until 31st January 2027, whichever occurs sooner.*


*Fair Usage Policy applies.*


*18+ only. RevPoints T&Cs apply. RevPoints earned depend on plan.*


*United Kingdom, Poland, and the Netherlands. Also now live (post-September) in Germany.*


*VIP numbers cost a one-off fee of €10.*
